parameters.apprise_url_plus: azure://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.source_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.tenant_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.client_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.secret_secret }} }
parameters.description:
Send an email notification to your own Office 365 destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-office365_email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `azure://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.

client_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Office 365 client id

secret_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Office 365 secret

source_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Office 365 source

tenant_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Office 365 tenant
